description: Read one approval: the held action, who asked, its status, the reason given and when it was decided. approval_id is the id from list_approvals or the notification that announced it. Needs a Last Price credential with audit read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

approval_id.description: The approval id, as list_approvals gives it.

name: get_approval
